name: table
label: Table
description: Name of the table to post the new journal entry to

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: The unique identifier for the record

name: activityStreamTitle
label: Activity stream title
description: Text to show for the title of the activity stream component

name: composeTitle
label: Activity compose title
description: Text to show for the title of the activity compose component

name: events
label: Events
description: Array of events. When the array is provided, the component saves the first request to the server

name: fields
label: Fields definition
description: Defines which fields to show, hashmap object or json string with the format { field_name : { name:string, label:string, sys_readonly:bool, readonly:bool, visible:bool, type:'journal_input', maxLength:number }, ... }

name: filterOptions
label: Filter options
description: Array of filter options in the shape of {isSelected: true, label: 'Filter label', name: 'name'}

name: extraParams
label: Extra parameters
description: Extra parameters to pass to the activity stream from the Form Controller

name: isNewRecord
label: New record
description: Tells whether or not the current record is newly created or not

name: isSideBySideViewAvailable
label: Is side-by-side available available
description: Tells whether or not the side-by-side layout should be available

name: userReferences
label: User references
description: Array of user information to reuse across events

name: ambChannels
label: AMB Channels
description: Array of AMB channels to connect to

name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
description: Current timestamp, this is used to know when new data is coming in

name: suppressPreviewRecord
label: Suppress Preview Record
description: Whether or not the activity combo component should supporess PREVIEW_RECORD and redispatch NOW_ACTIVITY_COMBO#PREVIEW_RECORD_REQUESTED action

name: userSession
label: User session information
description: Object containing the user session information

name: featureFlags
label: Feature flags
description: Array of feature flags in the format {name: 'name', value: 'value'}
